comparison.objective: Move a shelf wider than a cabinet face opening through the opening, level it, and lower it onto four pins.
comparison.physical_skill: In-hand 3D reorientation of a large rigid panel through a constrained aperture followed by four-point placement.
comparison.success_condition: Shelf passes the opening, rests level on all four pins, is released and stable, and neither cabinet nor shelf is damaged.
comparison.reason: This tests large-object spatial reorientation and multi-support seating, not impact tooling or fragment recovery.
